title: Same-Visit Covered-History Allowance (Workmanship Warranties)
content:
**Clause.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, a same-visit covered-history allowance is added into the same-visit courtesy sum on a Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty or Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty. The same-visit covered-history allowance follows all the inspections on the coverage that found a concern covered: the frequent covered-finding count of 3 or more, the frequent covered-history allowance of USD 4.00; exactly two, the repeat covered-history allowance of USD 2.00; fewer than two, no same-visit covered-history allowance.

| Inspections on the coverage that found a concern covered | Same-visit covered-history allowance |
|---|---|
| none or one | none |
| exactly two | USD 2.00 |
| three or more | USD 4.00 |

All covered findings on the coverage count, whatever the concern and whatever the date; findings of not covered do not count.

## Hypothetical cases

- A coverage with one covered finding at the visit and one covered finding two years earlier: two covered findings, USD 2.00.
- A coverage with three covered findings over its life: USD 4.00.
- A coverage whose only covered finding is the one at the visit: no allowance.
